we have identified a new candidate urinary biomarker for DN, uEGF.
the utility of a biomarker in a clinical setting is not determined by its presence in a model of a particular disease, but by its presence in multiple models and in the disease itself.
the utility of a biomarker for progressive decline in renal dysfunction in patients with type II diabetes and normal albuminuria should be assessed in other populations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
urinary peptidomics can be used to identify novel candidate biomarkers for diabetic kidney disease.
